'''Malik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked aboard the [[Haj Shipping Lines]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Star of Empire]]'' in [[1 ABY/Legends|the year following]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Malik was secretly working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], tasked with installing the [[Systems Infiltration Manager|SIM]] into the liner's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] for its first test.
